task: Classify the customer's message to an online banking app by the intent behind it. Choose the single intent that best matches what the customer is asking about or reporting.

labels.Refund_not_showing_up: A refund the customer was promised or has been sent has not appeared in their account.
labels.activate_my_card: The customer has a new card and wants to activate it or asks how to.
labels.age_limit: Asking about the minimum age to open or use an account.
labels.apple_pay_or_google_pay: Asking about using Apple Pay or Google Pay with the account or card.
labels.atm_support: Asking which ATMs can be used, or where to find ATMs that work with the card.
labels.automatic_top_up: Asking about setting up or using automatic top-ups of the account.
labels.balance_not_updated_after_bank_transfer: The balance has not changed after the customer made a bank transfer into the account.
labels.balance_not_updated_after_cheque_or_cash: The balance has not changed after the customer deposited a cheque or cash.
labels.beneficiary_not_allowed: A transfer to a beneficiary (recipient) is not allowed or was rejected for that recipient.
labels.cancel_transfer: The customer wants to cancel or reverse a transfer they have made.
labels.card_about_to_expire: The card is close to its expiry date; asks about renewal or a replacement.
labels.card_acceptance: Asking where the card is accepted, or whether a merchant or place will take it.
labels.card_arrival: The customer has ordered a card and asks where it is or why it has not arrived yet.
labels.card_delivery_estimate: Asking how long card delivery takes, or when a card will be delivered.
labels.card_linking: Asking how to link an existing card to the app or account.
labels.card_not_working: The card does not work, without a specific cause such as expiry, loss or a declined payment.
labels.card_payment_fee_charged: A fee was charged on a card payment.
labels.card_payment_not_recognised: The customer sees a card payment they do not recognise.
labels.card_payment_wrong_exchange_rate: A card payment in a foreign currency used the wrong or an unexpected exchange rate.
labels.card_swallowed: An ATM kept or swallowed the card.
labels.cash_withdrawal_charge: A charge or fee was applied to a cash withdrawal.
labels.cash_withdrawal_not_recognised: The customer sees a cash withdrawal they do not recognise.
labels.change_pin: The customer wants to change their card PIN, or asks how to.
labels.compromised_card: The customer thinks the card details have been compromised, or that someone else has used the card.
labels.contactless_not_working: Contactless payments with the card are not working.
labels.country_support: Asking in which countries the service or account is available.
labels.declined_card_payment: A card payment was declined or rejected.
labels.declined_cash_withdrawal: A cash withdrawal at an ATM was declined or rejected.
labels.declined_transfer: A transfer was declined or rejected.
labels.direct_debit_payment_not_recognised: The customer sees a direct debit payment they do not recognise.
labels.disposable_card_limits: Asking about the limits that apply to disposable virtual cards.
labels.edit_personal_details: The customer wants to change personal details such as name, address, phone number or email.
labels.exchange_charge: Asking about the fee charged for exchanging currency.
labels.exchange_rate: Asking what the exchange rate is, or how it is set.
labels.exchange_via_app: Asking how to exchange currency in the app, or which currencies can be exchanged there.
labels.extra_charge_on_statement: There is an unexplained or extra charge on the statement.
labels.failed_transfer: A transfer failed or did not go through.
labels.fiat_currency_support: Asking which fiat (ordinary government) currencies are supported.
labels.get_disposable_virtual_card: Asking how to get or create a disposable virtual card.
labels.get_physical_card: Asking how to get a physical card.
labels.getting_spare_card: Asking for an extra or spare card in addition to the one already held.
labels.getting_virtual_card: Asking how to get a virtual card (not a disposable one).
labels.lost_or_stolen_card: The card has been lost or stolen.
labels.lost_or_stolen_phone: The phone with the banking app has been lost or stolen.
labels.order_physical_card: The customer wants to order a physical card now.
labels.passcode_forgotten: The customer has forgotten their passcode (app or account login code).
labels.pending_card_payment: A card payment still shows as pending.
labels.pending_cash_withdrawal: A cash withdrawal still shows as pending.
labels.pending_top_up: A top-up still shows as pending.
labels.pending_transfer: A transfer still shows as pending.
labels.pin_blocked: The card PIN is blocked, for example after too many wrong attempts.
labels.receiving_money: Asking how to receive money into the account.
labels.request_refund: The customer wants to request a refund for a purchase or payment.
labels.reverted_card_payment?: A card payment was reversed or cancelled, and the customer asks about it.
labels.supported_cards_and_currencies: Asking which cards and which currencies are supported.
labels.terminate_account: The customer wants to close or delete their account.
labels.top_up_by_bank_transfer_charge: Asking about a charge or fee for topping up by bank transfer.
labels.top_up_by_card_charge: Asking about a charge or fee for topping up by card.
labels.top_up_by_cash_or_cheque: Asking about topping up the account with cash or a cheque.
labels.top_up_limits: Asking about the limits on top-ups.
labels.top_up_reverted: A top-up was reversed or cancelled.
labels.topping_up_by_card: Asking how to top up the account using a card.
labels.transfer_fee_charged: A fee was charged on a transfer.
labels.transfer_into_account: Asking how to transfer money into the account.
labels.transfer_not_received_by_recipient: A transfer the customer sent has not been received by the recipient.
labels.transfer_timing: Asking how long a transfer takes, or when it will arrive.
labels.unable_to_verify_identity: The customer tried to verify their identity but could not, or the verification failed.
labels.verify_my_identity: Asking how to verify their identity, or what is needed for it.
labels.verify_source_of_funds: Asking about verifying the source of funds, or how to do it.
labels.virtual_card_not_working: A virtual card does not work.
labels.visa_or_mastercard: Asking whether the card is Visa or Mastercard, or which can be chosen.
labels.why_verify_identity: Asking why the bank needs to verify their identity.
labels.wrong_amount_of_cash_received: The cash received from an ATM was not the amount requested.
labels.wrong_exchange_rate_for_cash_withdrawal: A cash withdrawal in a foreign currency used the wrong or an unexpected exchange rate.
